basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old history enthusiast based in Boston, Massachusetts. I work as a high school history teacher, which fuels my passion for discussions around historical events and their implications. When I'm not grading papers, you'll find me exploring local historical sites or engaging in online debates about historical accuracy. I’m single and often spend my evenings on Reddit, typically between 7 PM and midnight. I have a keen interest in societal structures and enjoy dissecting the nuances between political ideologies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in history stems from a Bachelor's degree in History and Political Science and years of teaching experience. I have a particular interest in 20th-century political movements and enjoy self-studying through books and documentaries.
